title: Badly made
text:
Badly made. I really wanted to love this but the quality is honestly not good. It is cute from afar. But the details and construction are awful.

The sparkly silver paint was chipped off of the star on arrival and revealed a bright blue material underneath. The whole thing was assembled with hot glue and it was messily done. There are strands and chunks of it deeply stuck into the branches. The star is falling off of the top and the whole thing is incredibly crooked! The branches can be bent but the center part won’t go straight.

Not worth the price for this when you can get something much better made for less elsewhere.
